messages:
Maria Ortega: FYI Acme flagged a P2: intermittent 503s on /v1/generate and SAML provisioning errors during the same window. They also report ~36h of missing audit events and are asking for a billing credit. Filing here to triage.

Raj Patel: Got it. Can you drop exact timestamps and any request IDs so I can correlate with infra traces and KMS logs?

Maria Ortega: Customer window: 2026-03-12 02:15-03:05 UTC. Example request-id: r-9f8e7d6c5b. Their IdP shows AssertionConsumerService failures at 02:18. Our webhook delivery shows 502s around 02:17-02:25.

Samir Khan: audit-bot shows shipper delivery failures earlier this morning. Need to know whether payloads were lost or queued. Any kms decrypt errors in that window?

Raj Patel: Found a restart on node inference-gw-3 at 02:16 (kernel patch), and autoscaler activity with queued requests. That could explain 503s/latency. Pulling audit-service and kms logs now.

audit-bot: Alert: audit-shipper unable to POST to longterm-store between 2026-03-11T23:40:00Z and 2026-03-12T04:10:00Z. Upstream returned 502 Bad Gateway. Rule=audit-shipper-delivery-failure

Samir Khan: That matches the missing window. Raj, can you paste the kms proxy log lines around 02:18?

Raj Patel: KMS proxy snippet:
```
[2026-03-12T02:18:03Z] ERROR decrypt key=projects/redwood/kms/keys/tenant-rot-02 err=502 Bad Gateway
[2026-03-12T02:18:03Z] WARN decrypt retry attempt=1
[2026-03-12T02:18:06Z] INFO decrypt succeeded attempt=2
```
Looks transient but provisioning jobs that don't retry might have failed.

Ida Liu: Customer SCIM logs show `400 provisioning incomplete` at 02:18 with our body `{\"error\":\"internal_provision_failed\"}`. They retried and users came through on retry.

Samir Khan: Two issues to address: (1) audit-shipper delivery 5xx to longterm-store -> potential backlog and delayed retention; (2) kms proxy transient 5xx -> causes SCIM failures.

Maria Ortega: Customer wants timeline + credit proposal. Also want confirmation on whether audit gaps could indicate data exposure or tampering.

Samir Khan: No sign of exfil. audit-shipper failed at our upstream longterm-store (server-side 502). Shipper queued payloads locally; we'll verify integrity and re-deliver. Opening security investigation to confirm no tampering.

Raj Patel: Action plan for infra repro and fixes:
- Reproduce audit-shipper against a mocked longterm-store that returns intermittent 502s.
- Reproduce SCIM provisioning against a mocked KMS proxy that returns 502 for first decrypt.
- Run `./bin/audit-shipper --target=http://localhost:9000/mock --retry=3 --backoff=exp`
- Sample repro curl: `curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/provision -d '{\"user\":\"test@acme.com\"}' -H 'X-Request-ID: repro-7001'`

Ida Liu: I'll draft a customer-facing one-line: "We observed transient upstream failures in our audit ingestion and KMS proxy which caused delayed audit delivery and intermittent SCIM provisioning errors; we're re-delivering queued audit events and will propose a billing adjustment if platform fault is confirmed." Thoughts?

Samir Khan: Good. Add: "No evidence of data exfiltration; integrity checks are in progress."

Maria Ortega: Owners: Raj - infra follow-up and telemetry (check shipper queues, longterm-store logs, network hops). Raj/eng-infra - add alerting for kms-proxy 5xx bursts and increase shipper retry/backoff. Sam - security integrity check on queued payloads. Ida - customer timeline and credit proposal.

Raj Patel: I'll post a first update by EOD with findings. Preliminary check shows shipper queue directories have data files timestamped in the window; I will validate checksums and delivery status.

Ida Liu: Customer asked whether they should re-run their SCIM sync scripts. Best practice to retry idempotently; we've seen retries succeed. I'll recommend a manual retry for immediate remediation and we'll follow up if we need to backfill provisioning events.

Maria Ortega: Suggest docs update: SCIM best practices to include idempotent retries and guidance around transient KMS errors. Also consider an automated notice to tenants when audit delivery is delayed beyond X minutes.

audit-bot: Incident recorded: #INC-2026-317. Assigned teams: eng-infra, security, support.

Samir Khan: If longterm-store root cause is confirmed, plan to run proactive backfill for affected tenants and notify them. Also propose a small billing credit for the impacted window.

Maria Ortega: Leaving thread open. Ping here with any blocking findings or if anyone needs me to contact Acme directly.
